Program
Overview

As a member of the Commonwealth of Nations, the Dominica Citizenship by Investment (CBI) Programme, established in 1993, is recognized as one of the most efficient and cost-effective programs in the Caribbean. It is widely regarded as a durable and highly sought-after CBI option on the global stage. Since 2017, Dominica has consistently ranked at the top of the CBI Index, reflecting its excellence and credibility in the industry.

Eligibility Criteria

  1. Main Applicant

    • At least 18 years of age
    • No criminal record
    • Source of funds fulfills investment requirements

  2. Eligibility of Dependents

    • Spouse of the main applicant
    • Unmarried children under 30 years of age enrolled in full-time study (maximum 29 at point of submission)
    • Parents and parents in law above 65 years of age

Program Benefits

  • Global mobility: Easier travel opportunities, facilitating international business and personal travel
  • Tax incentives: Absence of capital gains tax, wealth tax, and inheritance tax, providing an attractive option for wealth preservation
  • Cost-effective and efficient program
  • Family Friendly: the right to citizenship for life and to pass down to future generations

About the Dominica Program

The Dominica Citizenship by Investment (CBI) program was introduced in 1993. Now, it has become one of the world’s longest-running second citizenship programs. Qualifying investors have a legally recognised pathway to full Dominican citizenship.

The base investment starts from US$200,000, excluding the processing fees and due diligence fees. The processing time of an application is 6-9 months. This is subject to your documentation and background checks. Applicants aren’t required to relocate or establish physical residency in Dominica at any stage of the application.

North Arista is an authorised agent for the Dominica CBI Program. We work directly with investors to prepare applications and submit them on their behalf.

Benefits of Having Dominica Citizenship

The Dominica citizenship by investment program offers usable mobility. Dominican passport holders have visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to a number of countries. Henley Passport Index ranks Dominica 29th globally. Approved applicants can visit the Schengen Area, Singapore, Hong Kong, South Korea, etc.

For investors in Southeast Asia, a Dominican passport removes obstacles to international business. Schengen access can open up 27 European countries.

Both investment options are identical: Dominican citizenship and a passport valid for ten years, renewable indefinitely. Dual citizenship is allowed, meaning you do not need to give up your existing nationality. 

Dominica levies no taxes on foreign-sourced income, capital gains, inheritance, or net wealth for residents or citizens who are not resident in Dominica. Individual tax positions vary based on residency and investment structure.

Investment Routes and Costs

The cost of Dominica citizenship by investment depends on the route you select.

  1. A) Economic Diversification Fund (EDF) — Starting From US$200,000

The EDF requires a minimum contribution of US$200,000. This is a non-refundable contribution directed toward national development projects in Dominica. Most qualifying investors with a single application choose this route.

  1. B) Approved Real Estate — Starting From US$200,000

The real estate route requires a minimum investment of US$200,000 in government-approved real estate. Property must be held for at least 3 years. Approved options include shares in licensed eco-resorts and hospitality developments in the country.

A Note on Total Cost

The total Dominica passport costs for a single applicant are $210,750 for the EDF route and $285,750 for the real estate route. This includes applicable government and processing fees. The fee structure may be revised at any stage and is subject to government policies.

North Arista provides a complete cost breakdown during your eligibility assessment.

Dominica Citizenship by Investment Processing Time

Application approval time varies between 6 and 9 months. The actual timeline of the process depends on your documentation, the due diligence review, and current government processing volumes. Incomplete or inconsistent paperwork causes delays.

North Arista works with investors to ensure accurate documentation and reduce the risk of rejection at any stage.

Dominica Citizenship Requirements

Applicants must meet the program’s eligibility and due diligence standards. Applicants must be properly vetted by the Citizenship Unit (CBIU). A mandatory virtual interview is required for every applicant aged 16 and over.

All investment funds must originate from a verifiable, legal source, and the qualifying investment must be made through an approved route.

Dominica allows dual citizenship. There is no minimum physical residency requirement.

Important 2026 Update: The Government of Dominica has announced it will require all successful citizenship program applicants to collect and renew their passports in Dominica, representing a significant change from the program’s previously fully remote process. North Arista keeps clients informed of all regulatory updates.

Check Your Eligibility

The minimum US$200,000 investment does not represent your total application cost. Government fees, due diligence, and applicable processing charges may be included.

A Closer Look: Strategizing Your Dominica Plan

When clients ask us for a second citizenship recommendation, they often assume all Caribbean programs are virtually identical. We always tell them to look closer. Known globally as the “Nature Isle of the Caribbean”, Dominica stands out for very specific reasons.

Established back in 1993, its citizenship-by-investment program is one of the longest-running in the world. The initiative was originally launched to help the island broaden its economic foundation and stimulate new growth sectors. That shift successfully transformed the island into a premier destination for sustainable tourism and global investors. But beyond the stunning landscapes, why do so many smart entrepreneurs choose this specific nation? Let’ s break down the realities of the program and what it actually means for your daily life.

The Asian and European Mobility Edge

Let’s talk directly about travel. The true Dominica citizenship benefits deliver massive value to executives who do heavy business across Asia and Europe.

While some investors focus purely on total country counts, our clients care more about access to the right places. Holding dominica passport provides visa-free or visa-on-arrival entry to the European Schengen Area. But its hidden superpower is its Asian footprint – most notably, the visa-free entry it offers to mainland China. Being able to fly directly into the mainland without dealing with complicated business visa applications is a major advantage for international entrepreneurs. And it also grants straightforward access to Hong Kong, Macau, Singapore, and Thailand, along with many other important business hubs across the region.

If your supply chain or business meetings require constant movement between European capitals and Asian financial centers, this passport completely changes how you travel. You skip the usual visa wait times and fly on your own schedule.

A Safe Haven and the Ultimate Backup Plan

When you make a life-changing investment, you want to know the host country offers genuine, long-term security. Dominica is highly regarded for having one of the lowest crime rates in the region, making it an exceptional choice if you are looking for a secure backup plan during times of global uncertainty.

But true stability goes beyond low crime rates. What really catches our clients’ attention is how forward-thinking the Dominica government is. Following recent global climate challenges, Dominica committed to becoming the world’s first fully climate-resilient nation. They are actively harnessing geothermal energy to reduce reliance on imported fuels and building robust, hurricane-proof infrastructure. When you look closely, you realize you are investing in a nation that is proactively securing its own economic and environmental future. You gain a peaceful, environmentally conscious retreat without any physical residency requirements, giving you total flexibility and peace of mind.

Choosing Your Investment Path

How do you actually structure the investment? Choosing your route for dominica citizenship by investment usually depends on whether you prefer a straightforward financial contribution or acquiring a tangible asset.

The Economic Diversification Fund (EDF) is incredibly popular among clients who prefer simplicity. You make a single contribution that directly supports the country’s national development. These funds foster sustainable growth by backing sectors like renewable energy, local healthcare, and eco-tourism. Many of the families we work with tell us it feels highly rewarding to know their capital is actively helping to build resilient communities and create local jobs. Beyond that personal satisfaction, investors appreciate this route because it is a clean, one-time payment. Once it clears, you never have to worry about future resale processes or property upkeep.

If you prefer holding physical assets, the real estate route here is quite unique. Dominica focuses heavily on luxury eco-resorts and world-renowned hotel brands hidden within its mountainous terrain. You purchase a unit in a government-approved development, which you must hold for at least three years after your citizenship is granted. If you eventually plan to sell the property to another buyer applying for the same citizenship program, you simply hold it for five years. This option allows you to earn potential rental income from the island’s booming ecotourism sector during the holding period and also provides a clear timeline for resale later on.

Navigating the Interview and Vetting Process

We always advise our clients to look for programs with strict rules. Rigorous vetting protects the long-term reputation of your new passport, and the core Dominica citizenship requirements reflect exactly that.

The government conducts thorough background checks. You will need to provide standard documents showing an excellent personal history and clearly explain where your investment funds came from. As part of its enhanced security framework, all applicants aged 16 and older must also complete a mandatory virtual interview.

Hearing the word “interview” can make some people nervous, but there is honestly no need to stress. We have successfully guided countless families through this exact step. Instead of just giving you a list of required documents, our consultants actively help you organize your financial history so it is easy for the authorities to review. We also provide clear, practical guidance on what to expect during the virtual conversation, ensuring you feel completely confident and prepared when the time comes.

What to Expect: Clear Timelines

Securing your Dominica citizenship typically takes anywhere from 6 to 7 months. One of the biggest reasons we recommend this program is how remarkably fast and stable the entire process is. While many other global residency and citizenship programs face extended processing queues and unpredictable delays, the official unit here operates with high efficiency, ensuring your application proceeds both swiftly and steadily. But what does that timeline actually mean for you practically?

The first month is entirely focused on documentation preparation. We sit down with you to compile, translate, and verify your records, building a rock-solid application. Once your file is officially submitted, the government begins its rigorous due diligence process. This is your standard waiting period. You do not need to put your life or business on hold. Our processing team monitors the progress and keeps you updated.

During this review window, you will also complete the mandatory virtual interview. After you clear all background checks, the government issues an official approval letter. You only transfer your major investment funds after receiving this official green light. Once the payment clears and your passports are issued, the status is yours for life. Congratulations, you and your family are officially welcomed as citizens of Dominica.
